Subject: Draft MAP & timeline options — ClearSight / Redwood

Hi Olivia — great conversation earlier today, thanks to you and Rajiv for the time. As promised, attaching an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a high-level timeline so we can align next steps and owners. Quick recap and asks below: 

Call recap (30 min):
- Goal: Replace on-prem inference for analytics scoring with Redwood-hosted inference for interactive product features (low-latency embeddings + generation)
- Success criteria: 95th pctile latency < 200ms for 512-token requests, end-to-end cost target < $0.0008/token, HIPAA-compliant data handling for PII fields
- Key stakeholders: Olivia Barnes (Product), Rajiv Singh (Finance), Maria Lopez (InfoSec), Procurement (contracts@clearsight.com)

Attachments included: ClearSight_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft milestones/owners), Redwood_SOW_estimate_v1.pdf, SOC2_evidence_index.pdf

Initial MAP — two timeline options (pick one or suggest changes):
1) Standard cadence (recommended): 6 weeks to production acceptance
   - Week 1: Finalize MAP + procurement kickoff (ClearSight: Rajiv / Procurement; Redwood: Marissa)
   - Weeks 2–3: Security review & network test (ClearSight: Maria; Redwood: Marcus)
   - Weeks 4–5: Pilot integration + performance tuning (ClearSight: engineering lead; Redwood: Marcus/SE)
   - Week 6: Production roll; final acceptance and billing start
   - Target close date: 2026-11-30

2) Expedited (riskier): 3 weeks to production acceptance (requires prioritized procurement + early access to sample data)
   - Same milestones compressed; Redwood will dedicate SE hours to accelerate testing
   - Target close date: 2026-11-17

Dependencies and open items:
- Procurement timeline and PO sign-off (ClearSight)
- Security questionnaire answers and any additional evidence requests (we attached SOC2 index)
- Network allowlist and sample payload for POC (sample anonymized dataset)

Please confirm: 1) which timeline you prefer, 2) final list of stakeholders (add names/emails if missing), and 3) any additional must-have milestones we should include in the MAP.

Next steps from our side once you confirm: Redwood will: 1) update the MAP with confirmed owners and dates, 2) produce a final SOW/estimate for review, 3) schedule a technical kickoff with Marcus (SE) for the sandbox integration.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick follow-up if helpful.

Best,
